changes: Added SEGA Day (June 3), Famicom Birthday (July 15), Spyro Anniversary (September 9) and Movie Night (first October weekend), with original pixel scenes, frames and matching recommendations.
Kept SEGA Day focused on other SEGA games, with Sonic retaining its own birthday collection. Fixed anniversary priority when a library weekend overlaps.
Replaced navigation emojis with six generated pixel-art icons, enlarged labels and aligned the controls across desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
Moved Games before Franchises and styled the seasonal horizontal scrollbar to match the plum interface.
Redrew the March and April scenery with fresh spring daylight, and repaired the December frame rails and unwanted colored bands.
Added changelog history with older/newer navigation, including published versions and the current local build.

Added platform-specific Main story and 100% completion estimates from archived community reports for 314 catalog games, with sample counts and source links. Missing reports remain explicitly unavailable.
Placed game-length estimates alongside the score and progress controls, and standardized the franchise navigation button.
Combined backup, sync, appearance and removed games into one tabbed profile panel; removed the separate footer entry.
Added Zelda, Kirby, Sonic, Metroid and Castlevania anniversaries on their verified original release dates.
Added Pinball Weekend, Harvest Days, Puzzle Picnic and Hidden Gems between existing events.
Created nine original pixel-art scenes and nine matching frames, shared by the header and seasonal recommendations.
Added illustrated event cards with dates, source links and theme previews to the calendar; countdowns include the new events.
Seasonal recommendations now use strict franchise and genre selections for the new collections. Existing holiday themes keep priority when dates overlap.
Redrew Puzzle Picnic with recognizable jigsaw pieces and falling-block puzzles in both its frame and background.
Added a full season and event calendar. Click the countdown to view active dates and event density.
Page reload now restores calendar-based scenery, seasonal recommendations and automatic music selection.
Reworked all 27 seasonal backgrounds into distinct, quiet pixel scenes shared by the header and recommendations.
Enlarged header decorations and rebuilt frame edges to stay continuous with long descriptions.
Expanded and balanced the pixel sticker collection; removed rejected items and revised the wand and Space Invaders sprite.
Seasonal games open by clicking the cover or description. External discoveries open their information page without a separate About the Game button.
Brightened Easter, Sakura, summer, Mario, New Year, Star Wars and arcade scenery; selected a warmer Christmas scene.
Centred the header with equal side columns and refreshed site controls with consistent plum surfaces, readable labels and focus states.
Added a compact pixel-art back-to-top button and a clickable version with publication status.
ON AIR now refreshes RetroAchievements; restored occasional gold frame highlights and enlarged the header logo.
Prevented old decorative textures from appearing during initial loading.
